Riverine flood hazard
description: Riverine (fluvial) flood hazard: inundation from the 100-year return-period river flood. Areas are flagged as hazardous where flood water depth exceeds 0.01 m.

name: Riverine flood exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to riverine flooding, living in areas affected by the 100-year river flood (flood depth > 0.01 m).

name: Coastal flood hazard
description: Coastal flood hazard: inundation from the 100-year return-period coastal flood. Areas are flagged as hazardous where flood water depth exceeds 0 m.

name: Coastal flood exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to coastal flooding living in areas affected by the 100-year coastal flood (flood depth > 0 m).

name: Tropical cyclone wind hazard
description: Tropical cyclone wind hazard: mean wind speed (m/s) of the 100-year return-period storm. Areas are flagged as hazardous where wind speed exceeds 17.5 m/s.

name: Tropical cyclone wind exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to tropical cyclone winds living in areas where the 100-year storm wind speed exceeds 17.5 m/s.

name: Agricultural drought hazard
description: Agricultural drought hazard: Agricultural Stress Index (ASI) at the 100-year return level, expressed as the percentage of cropland affected by drought. Areas are flagged as hazardous where ASI exceeds 30%.

name: Agricultural drought exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to agricultural drought: children living in areas where the 100-year Agricultural Stress Index exceeds 30%.

name: Heatwave frequency hazard
description: Heatwave frequency hazard: number of heatwave events per year at the 100-year return level. Areas are flagged as hazardous where frequency exceeds ~16 events.

name: Heatwave frequency exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to frequent heatwaves, living in areas where the 100-year heatwave frequency exceeds ~16 events per year.

name: Heatwave duration hazard
description: Heatwave duration hazard: length (days) of the longest heatwave per year at the 100-year return level. Areas are flagged as hazardous where duration exceeds ~94 days.

name: Heatwave duration exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to long heatwaves, living in areas where the 100-year heatwave duration exceeds ~94 days.

name: Heatwave severity hazard
description: Heatwave severity hazard: heatwave magnitude/intensity at the 100-year return level. Areas are flagged as hazardous where severity exceeds ~3.66 °C.

name: Heatwave severity exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to severe heatwaves, living in areas where the 100-year heatwave severity exceeds ~3.66 °C.

name: Extreme heat hazard
description: Extreme heat hazard: number of extreme hot days per year (temperature > 35°C) at the 100-year return level. Areas are flagged as hazardous where the count exceeds 35 days.

name: Extreme heat exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to extreme heat, living in areas where the 100-year count of extreme hot days exceeds 35 days per year.

name: Wildfire intensity hazard
description: Wildfire intensity hazard: 90th-percentile fire radiative power (MW) from FIRMS satellite detections. Areas are flagged as hazardous where intensity exceeds ~37.9 MW.

name: Wildfire intensity exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to intense wildfires: children living in areas where the 90th-percentile fire radiative power exceeds ~37.9 MW.

name: Wildfire frequency hazard
description: Wildfire frequency hazard: 90th-percentile count of fire detections (FIRMS). Areas are flagged as hazardous where the detection count exceeds ~4.9 km?² · yr?¹ .

name: Wildfire frequency exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to frequent wildfires, living in areas where the 90th-percentile fire detection count exceeds ~4.9 km?² · yr?¹ .

name: Sand and dust storm hazard
description: Sand and dust storm hazard: annual susceptibility to sand and dust storms (index 0-1). Areas are flagged as hazardous where susceptibility exceeds 0.

name: Sand and dust storm exposed population
description: Child population exposed to sand and dust storms: children living in areas with annual sand-and-dust-storm susceptibility above 0.

name: Air pollution (PM2.5) hazard
description: Air pollution hazard: fine particulate matter (PM2.5) concentration (µg/m³), 90th percentile over 1998-2023. Areas are flagged as hazardous where PM2.5 exceeds 5 µg/m³ (WHO annual guideline).

name: Air pollution (PM2.5) exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to PM2.5 air pollution: children living in areas where the 90th-percentile PM2.5 concentration exceeds 5 µg/m³ (WHO annual guideline).

name: Malaria hazard (Plasmodium vivax)
description: Malaria hazard (Plasmodium vivax): mean malaria incidence (cases per 1,000 people) over 2013–2022. Areas are flagged as hazardous where the value exceeds 0.001.

name: Malaria exposed population (Plasmodium vivax)
description: Total and child population exposed to P. vivax malaria, living in areas where the mean malaria incidence (cases per 1,000 people) > 0.001.

name: Malaria hazard (Plasmodium falciparum)
description: Malaria hazard (Plasmodium falciparum): mean malaria incidence (cases per 1,000 people) over 2013–2022. Areas are flagged as hazardous where the value exceeds 0.001.

name: Malaria exposed population (Plasmodium falciparum)
description: Total and child population exposed to P. falciparum malaria: children living in areas where the 2013–2022 mean malaria incidence (cases per 1,000 people) exceeds 0.001.

name: Earthquake hazard (lower threshold)
description: Earthquake hazard (lower threshold): peak ground acceleration (PGA, g) with a 475-year return period on rock (v2023). Areas are flagged as hazardous where PGA exceeds 0.09 g.

name: Earthquake exposed population (lower threshold)
description: Total and child population exposed to earthquakes (lower threshold), living in areas where the 475-year PGA exceeds 0.09 g.

name: Earthquake hazard (higher threshold)
description: Earthquake hazard (higher threshold): peak ground acceleration (PGA, g) with a 475-year return period on rock (v2023). Areas are flagged as hazardous where PGA exceeds 0.34 g.

name: Earthquake exposed population (higher threshold)
description: Total and child population exposed to strong earthquakes (higher threshold): children living in areas where the 475-year PGA exceeds 0.34 g.

name: Holocene volcanic hazard
description: Volcanic hazard: proximity to Holocene volcanoes. Areas are flagged as hazardous when within a 100 km buffer of a volcano.

name: Holocene volcanoes exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to volcanic hazard living within 100 km of a Holocene volcano.

name: Landslide hazard (higher threshold)
description: Landslide hazard (higher threshold): mean rainfall-triggered landslide susceptibility (1980-2018). Areas are flagged as hazardous where susceptibility exceeds 0.01.

name: Landslide exposed population (higher threshold)
description: Total and child population exposed to landslides (higher threshold): children living in areas where landslide susceptibility exceeds 0.01.

name: Landslide hazard (lower threshold)
description: Landslide hazard (lower threshold): mean rainfall-triggered landslide susceptibility (1980-2018). Areas are flagged as hazardous where susceptibility exceeds 0.01.

name: Landslide exposed population (lower threshold)
description: Total and child population exposed to landslides (lower threshold): children living in areas where landslide susceptibility exceeds 0.01.

name: Meteorological drought (SPI) hazard
description: Meteorological drought hazard (SPI): frequency of drought based on the 12-month Standardized Precipitation Index (TerraClimate, 1958-2025). Areas are flagged as hazardous where the probability of SPI < -1.5 exceeds ~0.091.

name: Meteorological drought (SPI) exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to meteorological drought (SPI) living in areas where the probablity of  SPI < -1.5 exceeds ~0.091 for the 100-year return period.

name: Meteorological drought (SPEI) hazard
description: Meteorological drought hazard (SPEI): frequency of drought based on the 12-month Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index (TerraClimate, 1958-2025). Areas are flagged as hazardous where the value exceeds ~0.065.

name: Meteorological drought (SPEI) exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to meteorological drought (SPEI) living in areas where the probability of SPEI < -1.5 exceeds ~0.065 for the 100-year return period.

name: Conflict / complex-emergencies hazard
description: Conflict / complex-emergencies hazard: intensity of armed conflict and political violence from ACLED event data, gridded from event buffers. Areas are flagged as hazardous where conflict intensity is at or above 0 (conflict with no fatalities).

name: Conflict / complex-emergencies exposed population
description: Total and child population exposed to conflict / complex emergencies, living in areas affected by ACLED-recorded armed conflict and political violence.

name: Total population (Worldpop 2025)
description: Total resident population used as the denominator/base for exposure, derived from WorldPop 2025 (constrained, 100 m). Broken down by sex (total/male/female) and by under-18 age group.
